research_rationale:
EO 14368 of December 18, 2025, Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay (90 FR 60521; FR Doc. 2025-23844; published December 23, 2025), was read in full from the held Federal Register text. It adopts the 2026 pay schedules (Schedules 1 to 10) for the statutory pay systems, the Senior Executive Service, the Executive Schedule and related offices, the uniformed services, locality payments and administrative law judges, makes Schedule 8 effective January 1, 2026 and the other schedules effective on the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after January 1, 2026, and supersedes EO 14132 of December 23, 2024. On 2026-10-14 no held instrument had amended, revoked or superseded it, and the order has no own-terms end, so every clause is operative on the cutoff. The current-law:usc search found the whole order printed in the U.S. Code as a note to 5 U.S.C. 5332. The inventory was corrected in two places: the stray fragment '7.' that the dossier listed as its own clause is rejoined to section 3(c), and the dossier's section 4 is split into its two commands (the uniformed-services pay rates and the Director of OPM's assessment directive) because they have different histories. Section 5(b)'s Federal Register publication step, section 4's assessment directive and the effective-date and supersession clauses are recorded operative because no held source (held bytes) shows performance or an end; the packet embeds an OPM notice about the January 2026 pay schedules, but its source file is not held in this checkout, so it is not cited.
